title: Novel carboranyl-BODIPY conjugates: design, synthesis and anti-cancer activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34643-34660
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07241C, Paper
Open Access

Chandra Sekhara Mahanta, Sunitee Hansdah, Kabita Khuntia, Bibhuti Bhusan Jena, Biswa Ranjan Swain, Subhadeep Acharya, Barada Prasanna Dash, Priya Ranjan Debata, Rashmirekha Satapathy
A series of BODIPY conjugates were synthesized. In vitro cytotoxicity against the HeLa cervical cancer cell line revealed that the carboranyl-BODIPY conjugates have the potential to be effective anticancer agents.
